skill.description: Provides practical SymPy guidance for exact algebra, calculus, equation solving, symbolic matrices, physics, advanced mathematics, formatted output, and code generation.
skill.summary: Solve and transform symbolic mathematics with exact SymPy workflows.

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, ordinary SymPy imports, symbolic constructors, dictionary keys, and documentation links. Five file-writing examples and the recommendation to use eval are confirmed because they can overwrite files or execute untrusted code. Separate examples directly parse interactive input and deserialize a pickle without a trust boundary, creating high-severity code-execution risks.

remediation.issue: Interactive input is passed directly to parse_expr.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated restricted grammar with an explicit symbol and operator allowlist. Do not pass untrusted text to parse_expr.

remediation.issue: The guidance demonstrates pickle.load without a trust warning.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pickle with a safe structured format and explicit node reconstruction. State that pickle files must never come from untrusted sources.

remediation.issue: The guidance recommends eval for reconstructing expressions.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the eval recommendation and document a constrained serialization method. Explicitly warn that eval must never process external or user-controlled text.

remediation.issue: Several export examples overwrite fixed filenames.
remediation.suggestion: Check for existing files, accept an explicit destination, and request confirmation before overwriting user content.

content.value_statement: Symbolic mathematics becomes difficult when exact forms, assumptions, and solver choices matter. This skill provides focused SymPy workflows for reliable exact computation.
actual_capabilities: Creates symbols with assumptions and manipulates expressions through simplification, expansion, factoring, and substitution.
Computes exact derivatives, integrals, limits, series, and differential equation solutions.
Solves algebraic, linear, nonlinear, and differential equations using appropriate SymPy solvers.
Performs symbolic matrix operations, eigenvalue analysis, linear systems, and vector calculations.
Supports mechanics, quantum physics, units, geometry, number theory, combinatorics, statistics, logic, and special functions.
Generates LaTeX, readable mathematical output, numerical functions, and C or Fortran source from symbolic expressions.
limitations: SymPy may return unevaluated expressions when no closed form is available.
Large symbolic expressions can consume substantial memory and computation time.
Numerical performance often requires conversion through lambdify and an external array library.
Generated code, parsed input, and serialized objects require independent validation before use.

use_cases.title: Derive Research Formulas
use_cases.description: Compute exact derivatives, integrals, limits, and parameterized solutions while preserving assumptions for reproducible scientific analysis.

use_cases.title: Build Numerical Functions
use_cases.description: Transform verified symbolic formulas into NumPy functions or generated source for engineering and software workflows.

use_cases.title: Teach and Verify Mathematics
use_cases.description: Solve algebra, calculus, and linear algebra exercises exactly, then verify results through substitution or symbolic identities.

prompt_templates.title: Solve and Verify an Equation
prompt_templates.prompt: Define x as real. Solve {equation} exactly with SymPy, verify every solution by substitution, and explain any domain restrictions.

prompt_templates.title: Perform an Exact Calculus Operation
prompt_templates.prompt: For {expression}, compute the requested {calculus operation}. Keep exact values and state assumptions about every symbol.

prompt_templates.title: Model a Matrix or Physics System
prompt_templates.prompt: Model {system} symbolically with parameters {parameters}. Derive the governing equations, solve them where possible, and check dimensions or matrix shapes.

prompt_templates.title: Generate and Validate Numerical Code
prompt_templates.prompt: Simplify {formula} symbolically. Generate {target language} output, identify numerical stability concerns, and propose tests against the exact expression.

output_examples.input: Solve x squared minus five x plus six equals zero and verify the roots.
output_examples.output: The exact roots are x = 2 and x = 3. Substitution makes the polynomial zero for both roots.

output_examples.input: Differentiate sine of x squared and keep the result symbolic.
output_examples.output: The derivative is two x multiplied by cosine of x squared.

output_examples.input: Find the eigenvalues of the matrix with rows [1, 2] and [2, 1].
output_examples.output: The eigenvalues are 3 and -1, each with multiplicity one.

best_practices: Define every symbol with appropriate assumptions before building expressions.
Use Rational or exact SymPy constants until numerical evaluation is explicitly required.
Verify solutions by substitution and test generated numerical functions against exact symbolic results.
anti_patterns: Do not parse untrusted expressions or deserialize untrusted pickle files.
Do not introduce floating-point values before exact symbolic work is complete.
Do not expand or simplify large expressions repeatedly without measuring cost.

faq.question: What does exact computation mean?
faq.answer: SymPy preserves symbolic values such as square roots, fractions, and pi instead of replacing them with floating-point approximations.

faq.question: Can SymPy solve every equation?
faq.answer: No. Some equations lack closed forms, require assumptions, or need numerical methods and an initial estimate.

faq.question: Does this skill install SymPy?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. SymPy and any optional numerical libraries must already be available in the Python environment.

faq.question: Can symbolic expressions become fast numerical functions?
faq.answer: Yes. Lambdify can convert verified expressions for NumPy or other supported numerical backends.

faq.question: Can I safely parse formulas supplied by users?
faq.answer: Not directly. Treat formulas as untrusted input and use a restricted grammar with explicit symbols and operators.

faq.question: Can the skill generate documents or source code?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers LaTeX output and Python, C, or Fortran generation. Review destinations and validate generated results before use.
